title: Storage Gateway: on-premises access to AWS storage

kcs.statement: AWS Storage Gateway is a hybrid cloud storage service that gives on-premises applications access to virtually unlimited AWS storage, keeping frequently used data in a local cache for low-latency access.

S3 File Gateway exposes S3 as NFS/SMB file shares. Volume Gateway presents iSCSI block volumes backed by S3 with EBS snapshots. Tape Gateway replaces physical backup tapes with a virtual tape library stored in S3 and Glacier.
Storage Gateway is for ongoing hybrid access to cloud storage from on-premises applications, not for a one-time bulk transfer of data into AWS.

problem_ideas: A company's backup software writes to tape libraries it wants to retire: which gateway type?
Office file servers run out of disk, but users need fast access to recent files: which gateway type?
An on-premises app needs iSCSI disks with cloud-backed snapshots: which gateway type?
A distractor offers Storage Gateway for a one-time 500 TB move: why is it the wrong tool?
Explain what the local cache gives on-premises users.
Classify each scenario as hybrid cloud or a pure cloud deployment, and say whether Storage Gateway fits.
